headline: Mauricio Pochettino's Man United moment has arrived. Is he ready?
description: Mauricio Pochettino faces the sizable challenge of restoring Man United to their former glory. Can he succeed where Michael Carrick, Ruben Amorim and others failed?

headline: Premier League live updates: Manchester City host Fulham in early match
description: Club soccer returns across Europe this weekend following the final international break of 2026, with Manchester City hosting Fulham to kick off Saturday's action.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Scott McTominay return to Man United?
description: Scott McTominay left Manchester United little over two years ago, but could he return as his Napoli contact runs down? Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Will Mauricio Pochettino start strongly at Man United? What his career stats say
description: Before Mauricio Pochettino leads Manchester United, how did his debuts at his previous teams go?

headline: Burley labels Pochettino has the biggest manager since Mourinho for Man United
description: ESPN's Nedum Onuoha, Craig Burley and Frank Leboeuf join Kay Murray to react to Mauricio Pochettino's first press conference as Manchester United manager.

headline: Pochettino: 'Massive' pressure with USMNT makes me better coach for Man United
description: Mauricio Pochettino said the experience of coaching the U.S. at the World Cup stands him in good stead for taking over Manchester United.
